steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Follow the route one instruction at a time. Listen for the landmark first, then the direction or transit choice.

steps.title: Finding the museum
steps.body: Sam asks a passerby for directions downtown.

examples.en: Sam: Excuse me. Where is the museum?

examples.fr: Oui. Tournez à gauche au feu rouge. Le musée est en face de la banque.
examples.en: Passante: Yes. Turn left at the traffic light. The museum is across from the bank.
Sam: Is it far from here?

examples.fr: Non, c'est à deux minutes à pied.
examples.en: Passante: No, it is two minutes away on foot.

steps.title: At the bus stop
steps.body: Sam checks whether the bus goes to the station.

examples.en: Sam: Hello. Where is the bus stop?

examples.fr: Il est devant la station, à droite.
examples.en: Employé: It is in front of the station, on the right.

examples.fr: Je vais au musée. Cette ligne va au centre-ville ?
examples.en: Sam: I am going to the museum. Does this route go downtown?

examples.fr: Oui. Vous allez descendre à la station du musée.
examples.en: Employé: Yes. You are going to get off at the museum station.

examples.fr: Je peux acheter un billet ici ?
examples.en: Sam: Can I buy a ticket here?

examples.fr: Oui, à la machine, près de l'entrée.
examples.en: Employé: Yes, at the machine, near the entrance.

examples.fr: Merci. Je vais attendre à l'arrêt.
examples.en: Sam: Thank you. I am going to wait at the stop.

steps.explain: The passerby says the museum is en face de la banque.

steps.prompt: How long does it take to walk there?
steps.explain: It is à deux minutes à pied.

options: In front of the station, on the right
On the left of the bank
steps.explain: The employee says devant la station, à droite.

steps.prompt: Where can Sam buy a ticket?
options: At the machine near the entrance
steps.explain: The employee points to the machine near the entrance.
